descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: phone-width / WebKit variant.

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S24 Tabs, toggles and the scan control at phone width and on WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 1; TFA-92587 How it works 1)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual-lane targets: Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Open /snf, switch to All Residents, tap a toggle

Then Both tabs, each toggle and the scan control are visible and tappable without overlap. A long resident name does not push the toggle off-screen

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Visual-lane deterministic checks (tap-target size, overflow, overlap) on the All Residents screen; screenshot kept as evidence

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.
